content:
**Official OpenAI announcement on X (September 29, 2026):** A thread from the verified @OpenAI account announcing the release of **GPT-6.1 Sol**. No separate official post was found for a distinct “GPT-6 Sol” announcement on this date; the thread repeatedly positions GPT-6.1 Sol as a direct upgrade over the prior GPT-6 Sol model.[[1]](https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2104986136745767160)

**Exact announcement source URL (canonical blog post linked in the thread):**  
https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-6-1-sol

**Availability today:** Yes — the lead post explicitly states it is “available starting today” to all Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Edu users in ChatGPT Work and Codex.[[1]](https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2104986136745767160)

### Thread details (all posts from the same thread, posted within seconds of each other on 29 Sep 2026):

- **Post ID:** 2104986129686741046  
  **Author:** @OpenAI  
  **Timestamp:** Tue, 29 Sep 2026 17:26:16 GMT  
  **Paraphrase:** Introduces GPT-6.1 Sol as near-Astra intelligence for one-fifth the price and the most cost-efficient model for its performance available today. (Includes video.)[[2]](https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2104986129686741046)

- **Post ID:** 2104986131238695200  
  **Author:** @OpenAI  
  **Timestamp:** Tue, 29 Sep 2026 17:26:17 GMT  
  **Paraphrase:** GPT-6.1 Sol makes frontier intelligence more affordable; cached input costs $0.10 per million tokens (95% less than standard, 50% less than GPT-6 Sol). (Includes image.)[[3]](https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2104986131238695200)

- **Post ID:** 2104986133004505373  
  **Author:** @OpenAI  
  **Timestamp:** Tue, 29 Sep 2026 17:26:17 GMT  
  **Paraphrase:** GPT-6.1 Sol is a significant upgrade over GPT-6 Sol in coding, computer use, and complex professional work, approaching GPT-6 Astra on several benchmarks at much lower cost. (Includes 3 images.)[[4]](https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2104986133004505373)

- **Post ID:** 2104986135005192665  
  **Author:** @OpenAI  
  **Timestamp:** Tue, 29 Sep 2026 17:26:17 GMT  
  **Paraphrase:** GPT-6.1 Sol shows major improvements over GPT-6 Sol in alignment evaluations, aligning it more closely with GPT-6 Astra; it is more transparent about limitations and better at respecting user intent and safety constraints. (Includes image.)[[5]](https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2104986135005192665)

- **Post ID:** 2104986136745767160  
  **Author:** @OpenAI  
  **Timestamp:** Tue, 29 Sep 2026 17:26:18 GMT  
  **Paraphrase:** GPT-6.1 Sol is available starting today to Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Edu users in ChatGPT Work and Codex. Links to the official blog post.[[1]](https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2104986136745767160)

**Distinction (per the posts):** GPT-6 Sol is the previous model that GPT-6.1 Sol improves upon in cost, performance (coding/professional tasks), alignment, transparency, and safety. No separate announcement URL or post for GPT-6 Sol appears in this search. All information is taken directly from the single combined X search of official OpenAI/Sam Altman/Greg Brockman accounts on the release date; no other posts were returned.
